title: Guru Gobind Singh's Encounter with Banda Singh Bahadur

blocks.text: The list of powers finally closes, and Jait Ram repeatedly warns the Guru not to go near Banda’s place, fearing what might happen if such siddhis are provoked directly.
Guru Gobind Singh refuses to be turned back, asks for a witness, and sets out anyway, treating the occult theater around Banda as something that must be tested rather than feared.
The page shifts the story from hearsay to motion: warning gives way to decision, and the meeting with Banda becomes unavoidable.
